name: Volume on Surface (VoS)
definition: An enhanced surface rendering algorithm that integrates surface and volume rendering to support visualization of internal volume structures. It maps volumetric domain grid information onto a boundary surface extracted from the volume grid via ray casting, enabling display of internal structures using conventional surface rendering.
summary: Volume on Surface (VoS) is a hybrid rendering technique that maps volumetric data onto an iso-surface to visualize internal structures efficiently, avoiding the high cost of full volume ray casting.
